boundary: H2 spec plant: packed lift slope = 0.58·finsLatAccel·η_q/finsAoa, linear in η_q with no elbow or saturation observed from η=0.55 to 1.7 (three-flight PL-12 fast/slow-launch + R-77 replay joint fit 2026-08, 59 frames, R²=0.97–0.998, thrust-lateral component T·sinα/(m·g) removed from the displayed G before fitting); loadFactorMax is retained only as an untested F_N output cap, not a slope elbow; I=m L^2/12, I ω̇ = K(δ-α)-Cω with K=N'Δ, C=2√(KI), ζ=1. Default autopilot is datamine accelControl PID → fin angle (v12) with error in g (pid_error_scale=1). pid_error_units=mps2 was tested and rejected: ×g0 makes a bang-bang relay and a ~5 Hz G limit cycle; faster actuators made it worse and 4× smaller dt did not change it. timeToHitGain t_go = R/max(Vc, |V_rel|) so beam shots cannot inflate t_go. The shared G-outer/rate-inner cascade remains an opt-in candidate. CdA0 = S_w·CxK·C_et(M) interpolated 1943-law*1.10, CdA_α = S_d·CxAoA·min(α,1.2)^2 with S_d=πd²/4 and no Mach shape, optional CdA_δ default 0; missing baseIndSpeed uses shared 1800 km/h, η_q capped at 4; reqAccelMax caps the gravity-compensated specific-force command. Midcourse PIP lead-turn (IOG+DL→TRK launch heading catch-up) is a declared candidate absent from the datamine; τ_turn=0.8 s (fit within the declared 0.3-0.8 s range to the PL-12 30° slow-launch replay; lock_delay_s=0.8, blend_time_s=0.5 kept at the declared default) and the term self-fades as heading error closes. The handover weight w(t) is 1 for t<lock_delay_s+hold_time_s then linear 1->0 across blend_time_s; hold_time_s defaults to 0.0 fleet-wide (collapses to the original lock_delay_s-only linear fade, bit-identical), and is an available per-missile override for a hold-then-release handover shape (see su_r_77/su_r_77_1's guidance.midcourse_lead_turn). midcourse_lead_turn.mode='pcc_alpha' (per-missile opt-in, R-77 family only as of 2026-08-26) replaces the timer/blend handover with the PCC-alpha capture candidate: a_cap=V*sin(eps)/tau_capture_s toward the loft-aware PIP, explicitly clipped to the thrust-inclusive alpha-limited envelope (capture_alpha_max_deg, h2_dynamics.capture_alpha_envelope_g), alpha-inverted to a direct fin command (delta=alpha trim), released when R_cap=|a_cap|/a_env falls through 1 (emergent, geometry-dependent), with a hysteresis CAPTURE/HOMING state machine (epsilon 2/15 deg, recapture only at R>=1, 0.1 s dwell); hold_time_s/blend_time_s/fin_error_ref_rad are not consumed in that mode. PCC-alpha v0.1 (2026-08-26) adds two shaping filters in the same block, both defaulting to 0.0 = off (fleet-wide bit-identical, and inert in timer_blend): release_washout_time_s asymmetrically washes the routed capture-alpha vector and its direct-routing weight out together (rise fixed at 0.05 s, decay = the key) so the fin command is continuous through the CAPTURE->HOMING handoff and relaxes into PN instead of stepping to zero; los_rate_filter_time_constant_s low-passes the LOS-rate vector before the PN product as a seeker-trackloop surrogate. R-77 family: 0.95 s / 0.0 (the LOS filter is implemented but calibrates to off), with epsilon_exit_deg widened 15->25 deg per-missile because the washout enlarges the post-handoff heading excursion. See docs/PCC_ALPHA_V0.md and docs/CAPTURE_RELEASE_DISCRIMINANT.md. Not an end-to-end validation or game-solver reproduction.
